title: 第23章 美丽废物的作用第24章 陷杀皇甫南
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
萧沁儿抬起白嫩的小手，指着一根竹子。
众人顺着小郡主所指望去，看到了一只停留在竹竿上的彩色蝴蝶。
“好美的蝴蝶。”
萧渊有些惊讶，一下就理解了女儿的心情。
落在竹上的蝴蝶约莫半尺长，双翅展开如画卷，似收纳了世间所有的瑰丽与奇幻。
翅面底色则是子夜深海般的深邃幽蓝，晕染着丝丝缕缕如梦如幻的紫芒。
惊鸿一瞥，再难忘怀。
尤其是对一个满怀童心的小女孩来说，更有着无与伦比的的诱惑力。
“显堂主，这只蝴蝶也是残蛊楼的蛊虫？”
萧渊问道。
“呃——”
蚩显语塞，凭气息来看这的确是一只蛊虫，但十二洞应该不会培育这类蛊虫才对。
想必是某只残蛊被培育后，错误进化了。
专业的事还是要找专业的人，萧渊看出蚩显不懂，便带着女儿走了回去。
“李元，那只蝴蝶是你养的吗？”
“嗯。”
李元点头。
这只蝴蝶正是被他称为‘美丽废物’的惊鸿蝶。
除了好看一无是处。
“哥哥，你可以把它卖给我吗？”

不待萧渊说话，小郡主萧沁儿就开口了。
“郡主喜欢的话，拿去就是。”
李元很大方。
反正是只美丽废物，对他来说毫无用处。
“娘亲说了，出门在外不能白拿别人的东西。”
萧沁儿认真道。
“出个价吧。”
萧渊笑了笑：“沁儿说得对，这只蝴蝶一看就不一般，想必培育时费了你很多精力和资源，我们不能白拿。”
李元：“……”
咱也就随手一合。
“你不必害怕，想要换什么直说就是。”
萧渊以为是李元碍于他的身份，不敢提要求。
“王爷误会了。”
李元缺少的只有时间。
“这样吧。”
萧渊从腰间取下一块令牌，
“等你想好了，可执此令牌来找我，或是找沧澜域其他人，他们都会帮你。”
“好。”
李元不再推诿。
沧澜王乐于交换，他也就顺其自然了。

拿了令牌，李元伸手一招，惊鸿蝶扇动双翅飞了过来，落在小郡主肩头。
“真的好美哇！”
content_en:
Xiao Qin'er raised her white and tender hand and pointed at a bamboo.
Everyone followed what the little princess wanted and saw a colorful butterfly staying on a bamboo pole.
"What a beautiful butterfly."
Xiao Yuan was a little surprised and understood his daughter's mood immediately.
The butterfly that landed on the bamboo was about half a foot long, with its wings spread out like a picture scroll, seeming to contain all the magnificence and fantasy in the world.
The background color of the wings is as deep as the deep sea at midnight, and is smudged with strands of dreamlike purple light.
A startling glimpse that will never be forgotten again.
Especially for a little girl full of childlike innocence, it has unparalleled temptation.
"Master Xian, is this butterfly also a Gu insect from the Canned Gu Tower?"
Xiao Yuan asked.
"Uh-"
Chi Xian was at a loss for words. Judging from the aura, this was indeed a Gu worm, but Twelve Cave probably wouldn't breed such Gu worms.
It must be that a certain residual Gu evolved by mistake after being cultivated.
For professional matters, you still need to find professional people. Xiao Yuan saw that Chi Xian didn't understand, so he took his daughter back.
"Li Yuan, did you raise that butterfly?"
"Yeah."
Li Yuan nodded.
This butterfly is the Jinghong butterfly that he calls "beautiful waste".
Nothing but good-looking.
"Brother, can you sell it to me?"
Before Xiao Yuan could speak, the little princess Xiao Qin'er spoke.
"If the princess likes it, just take it."
Li Yuan is very generous.
It's just beautiful trash anyway, and of no use to him.
"Mom said, don't take other people's things for free when you go out."
Xiao Qin'er said seriously.
"Make an offer."
Xiao Yuan smiled: "Qin'er is right, this butterfly looks extraordinary at first glance. You must have spent a lot of energy and resources cultivating it, so we can't take it in vain."
Li Yuan: "..."
Let's just do it casually.
"You don't have to be afraid, just say whatever you want to change."
Xiao Yuan thought that Li Yuan did not dare to make demands due to his status.
"Your Majesty misunderstood."
All Li Yuan lacks is time.
"So be it."
Xiao Yuan took off a token from his waist,
"When you have thought about it, you can use this token to come to me or other people in Canglan Region, and they will help you."
"Okay."
Li Yuan no longer shirks the blame.
King Canglan was happy to exchange, so he just went with the flow.
Taking the token, Li Yuan stretched out his hand and the Jinghong Butterfly flapped its wings and flew over, landing on the little princess's shoulder.
"It's so beautiful!"
